title: Step 63-F Address, delivery, quote, reservation, review and idempotent order submission
description: HIGH-risk Step 63-F. Productionize customer-owned Checkout Address, authoritative Delivery selection, Quote, reservation, final Review and idempotent Order creation on top of canonical Step 63-E. Payment initiation/status/verify and Order Outcome runtime remain forbidden for Stage 63-G. No backend business-rule, database, dependency, workflow or Current State mutation.

dependencies.evidence: PR #308 protected workflow_dispatch 37131544917; merge job 111227485574 SUCCESS; exact-SHA postmerge 111227552033 SUCCESS; terminal Lock release comment 5970424399.

acceptance_criteria.description: Address route reads only customer-owned addresses and supports selection, create, edit and set-default through existing authenticated APIs; selected IDs are revalidated against the account before use.
Delivery uses only methods and fees returned by GET /shipping-methods; optional coupon is transported only into the authoritative Quote request.
Review obtains authoritative Quote and Reservation, rotates Checkout credentials server-side, shows integer-Toman totals and never treats refresh/unknown results as success.
Order creation uses the currently owned address snapshot and an idempotency key; retry safety is delegated to the canonical idempotent backend command.
Payment initiation/verify/status and Order Outcome runtime remain deferred placeholders for Stage 63-G; Stage F does not fabricate payment success.
Persian RTL, 44px targets, focus visibility and responsive reflow are present; credentials never enter URL, route data, browser storage or user-visible diagnostics.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, CodeQL Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact Human Gate, ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 63-F is HIGH risk because it crosses authenticated address ownership, reservation and idempotent order creation. Final owner HUMAN approval must bind to the frozen exact head/artifact after technical/security gates are green. Direct-main write/raw merge prohibited.

graph_pre_mutation.terminal_requirement: Execute accumulated Step 63 graph health/query/path/explain evidence during final acceptance/closure before Step 64 handoff.

evidence.geography_contract_note: Customer Address requires province_id/city_id UUIDs, database has no geography FK, and no public geography lookup endpoint exists. Stage F uses deterministic opaque compatibility IDs and preserves human labels; it does not claim authoritative geography.
